title: asyncpg connections not returned to pool if task is cancelled

labels.name: external driver issues
labels.description: the issue involves a misbehavior on the part of the DBAPI itself, probably not SQLAlchemy

body:

**Describe the bug**
Using postgresql+asyncpg, I noticed a web app eventually runs out of connections and crashes. It turns out asyncpg connections are not returned to the pool when a task is cancelled.


**To Reproduce**
Provide your [Minimal, Complete, and Verifiable](http://stackoverflow.com/help/mcve) example
here.

```pyimport logging
import asyncio

from asyncio import current_task

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker


engine = create_async_engine('postgresql+asyncpg://your/db', pool_timeout=30, pool_recycle=1800,
                             pool_size=20, max_overflow=-1, future=True)
async_session_factory = sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession)

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logging.getLogger('sqlalchemy.engine').setLevel(logging.INFO)
logging.getLogger('sqlalchemy.pool').setLevel(logging.DEBUG)


async def get_and_return():
    async with AsyncSession(engine) as session:
        await session.execute('SELECT 1')


async def get_and_cancel():
    async with AsyncSession(engine) as session:
        await session.execute('SELECT 1')
        current_task().cancel()


async def main():
    for x in range(20):
        try:
            await get_and_return()
            logging.info(engine.pool.status())
            await get_and_cancel()
            logging.info(engine.pool.status())
        except asyncio.exceptions.CancelledError:
            pass


asyncio.run(main())
```

**Error**
Provide the complete text of any errors received **including the complete
stack trace**.   If the message is a warning, run your program with the
``-Werror`` flag:   ``python -Werror myprogram.py``

Correct behaviour from `get_and_return`
```
DEBUG:sqlalchemy.pool.impl.AsyncAdaptedQueuePool:Created new connection <sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection object at 0x000001815DF55DC0>
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:select version()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:[raw sql] ()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:select current_schema()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:[raw sql] ()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:show standard_conforming_strings
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:[raw sql] ()
DEBUG:sqlalchemy.pool.impl.AsyncAdaptedQueuePool:Connection <sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection object at 0x000001815DF55DC0> checked out from pool
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:BEGIN (implicit)
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:SELECT 1
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:[generated in 0.00011s] ()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:ROLLBACK
DEBUG:sqlalchemy.pool.impl.AsyncAdaptedQueuePool:Connection <sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection object at 0x000001815DF55DC0> being returned to pool
DEBUG:sqlalchemy.pool.impl.AsyncAdaptedQueuePool:Connection <sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection object at 0x000001815DF55DC0> rollback-on-return
INFO:root:Pool size: 20  Connections in pool: 1 Current Overflow: -19 Current Checked out connections: 0
```

Incorrect behaviour from `get_and_cancel`
```
DEBUG:sqlalchemy.pool.impl.AsyncAdaptedQueuePool:Connection <sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.asyncpg.AsyncAdapt_asyncpg_connection object at 0x000001815DF55DC0> checked out from pool
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:BEGIN (implicit)
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:SELECT 1
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:[cached since 0.0375s ago] ()
INFO:sqlalchemy.engine.Engine:ROLLBACK
...
INFO:root:Pool size: 20  Connections in pool: 1 Current Overflow: -18 Current Checked out connections: 1
```

As you can see, the ROLLBACK triggers, but the connection is not returned to the pool and 1 connection remains checked out. After running the full loop of 20 tries, 20 connections are checked out and not doing anything.

**Versions.**
 - OS: Windows 10, also tested in Alpine container
 - Python: 3.9.2
 - SQLAlchemy: 1.4.18
 - Database: Postgres 11
 - DBAPI: asyncpg 0.21.0
